name: Event Management
description: Complete event management workflow covering registration, speaker submissions, vendor applications, volunteer coordination, incident logging, budget tracking, and post-event feedback. Includes 7 forms and 1 app.

forms.title: Event Registration
forms.description: Register attendees for events with ticket selection, dietary requirements, and accessibility needs.

fields.label: Event Registration
fields.description: Welcome! Please complete this form to register for the event. We look forward to seeing you there.

fields.label: Registration Complete
fields.description: Thank you for registering! You will receive a confirmation email shortly with event details.

forms.title: Speaker / Presenter Submission
forms.description: Collect speaker proposals including topic, abstract, bio, and equipment requirements.

fields.label: Abstract
fields.description: Provide a summary of your talk (200-500 words).

forms.title: Vendor / Exhibitor Application
forms.description: Process vendor and exhibitor applications with booth preferences and insurance verification.

properties.placeholder: Describe what you will be showcasing or selling
Any special setup requirements or requests

forms.title: Volunteer Sign-Up
forms.description: Recruit and coordinate event volunteers with availability and skills tracking.

forms.title: Post-Event Feedback
forms.description: Collect attendee feedback after events to measure satisfaction and identify improvements.

properties.placeholder: How can we make the next event better?

fields.label: Would you attend this event again?
Would you recommend this event to others?

forms.title: Event Incident Log
forms.description: Document incidents that occur during events for safety records and post-event review.

properties.placeholder: What was done to address the incident?
Names and contact info of witnesses

forms.title: Event Budget Item
forms.description: Track event budget items with estimated vs. actual costs and variance calculation.

fields.label: Variance ($)
fields.description: Difference between estimated and actual cost (negative = over budget).

properties.placeholder: Additional notes about this budget item
